*Saraṇaduka, Parittattika* (Patthana 15.81) is an Abhidhamma text situated within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the canonical Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It combines the dyad on states accompanied by conflict (*saraṇa-duka*) with the triad on limited or minor states (*paritta-ttika*). No references or dedicated discussions of this specific section were identified in the consulted secondary research literature.

Further extensive parallel phrasing is shared with *Cūḷantaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 21.5), *Saraṇaduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.14), *Nahetusahetukaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.26), and *Saraṇaduka, Parittārammaṇattika* (Patthana 15.82) [DharmaNexus]. Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus identifies any curated or machine-aligned cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan collections [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
